description: Fetch one paper's full INSPIRE-HEP record by recid, arXiv ID, or DOI: contributors with affiliations and recorded roles, public attached-document links and identifiers, abstract, publication references, arXiv and DOI identifiers, keywords, subjects, citation counts, linked experiments, texkeys, and whether HEPData holds its numerical tables (record DOI, latest version, table count, hepdata.net link). Also returns ready-made literature queries for the papers citing it and for its references. Large collaboration papers can list thousands of authors; max_authors caps the list while authorCount gives the full number.

author_offset.description: Zero-based starting position in the normalized contributor list (default 0). Use nextAuthorOffset from the previous page.

max_authors.description: Most contributors to list (nonnegative integer, default 25; values above 500 use 500). Zero lists no contributors. The full count is always in authorCount.

paper.description: INSPIRE recid (e.g. 451647), arXiv ID (1207.7214 or hep-th/9711200, with or without 'arXiv:', a version suffix, or an https://arxiv.org/abs/ or https://arxiv.org/pdf/ prefix), DOI (10.1016/…, with or without 'doi:' or an https://doi.org/ prefix; no * or ? wildcards), an https://inspirehep.net/literature/<recid> URL, or HEPData's ins<recid> form, alone or in an https://www.hepdata.net/record/ins<recid> URL. Up to 256 characters.

name: cern_inspire_get_paper

abstract.description: Full abstract as text (arXiv-sourced when available): publisher markup converted like title, LaTeX left as published.

abstractSource.description: Who supplied the abstract (e.g. arXiv, a publisher).

alternateTitles.description: Other titles INSPIRE records (translations, preprint titles), converted to text like title.

arxivId.description: arXiv identifier, when the paper has one.

authorCount.description: Upstream contributor count, falling back to the available contributor list length.

authorOffset.description: Zero-based starting position in the normalized available contributor list.

authors.description: Contributors in record order from authorOffset, capped at the effective max_authors budget.

affiliations.description: Affiliations listed for this contributor on this paper.

bai.description: INSPIRE BAI (e.g. Edward.Witten.1), when known; pass as author to cern_inspire_get_citation_summary.

recid.description: INSPIRE author record ID, when linked; pass as query to cern_inspire_search_authors for the profile.

roles.description: Roles in recorded order; absent roles are unknown.

citationCount.description: Citations INSPIRE counts for the paper.

citationCountWithoutSelf.description: Citations excluding self-citations, when INSPIRE reports it.

citingQuery.description: Literature query for papers citing this one; pass to cern_inspire_search_literature.

collaborations.description: Collaborations credited on the paper; empty for most non-collaboration papers.

core.description: True when INSPIRE classes the paper as core HEP, when recorded.

date.description: Earliest date INSPIRE records for the paper: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

documents.description: Public attached-document links in record order; no file contents are fetched.

fulltext.description: Recorded full-text flag; absent means unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `paper_not_found`: The recid, arXiv ID, or DOI matches no INSPIRE literature record. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, was HTML where JSON was expected, or was invalid JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

experiments.description: Accelerator experiments linked to the paper.

recid.description: INSPIRE experiment record ID, when linked; pass as query to cern_inspire_search_experiments for the experiment record.

hepdata.description: HEPData availability for the paper's numerical tables.

hepdataUrl.description: The HEPData record page on hepdata.net, where the table values are read: keyed by the record number in recordDoi, or by this paper's recid (/record/ins followed by the recid) when recordDoi names no number.

inspireDataRecid.description: Record ID of the HEPData entry in INSPIRE's data collection.

otherRecords.description: The paper's other HEPData records, in ascending record number, when it has more than one (at most 9 listed); the fields above describe the lowest-numbered record among the up to 10 the lookup returns.

items.description: Another HEPData record of this paper.

hepdataUrl.description: The HEPData record page on hepdata.net, where the table values are read: keyed by the record number in recordDoi, or by this paper's recid (/record/ins followed by the recid) when recordDoi names no number.

inspireDataRecid.description: Record ID of the HEPData entry in INSPIRE's data collection.

recordDoi.description: HEPData record DOI; cite it when reusing the data.

tableCount.description: Number of tables in the latest version.

recordDoi.description: HEPData record DOI; cite it when reusing the data.

status.description: available: HEPData holds tables; none: it does not; lookup_failed: could not check.

tableCount.description: Number of tables in the latest version.

imposing.description: Who imposes the licence, when recorded.

material.description: Which version of the paper the licence covers (e.g. preprint, publication), when recorded.

mergedFrom.description: The recid asked for, when INSPIRE had merged that record into this one and redirects it here; cite and query this record by recid.

nextAuthorOffset.description: Pass as author_offset to read the next page; absent when no contributors remain or the budget is zero.

notice.description: Guidance when the recid asked for was merged into this record, the contributor list was capped, HEPData availability could not be checked, or the paper has more than one HEPData record.

articleId.description: Article ID, for journals that number articles.

refereed.description: True when published in a refereed venue, when recorded.

referencesQuery.description: Literature query for this paper's references; pass to cern_inspire_search_literature.

resolvedAs.description: Which identifier form the paper input was resolved from.

texkeys.description: INSPIRE texkeys (BibTeX citation keys), current first.

title.description: Title as text: publisher HTML, JATS, and MathML converted (scripts as _x or ^{xy}), LaTeX left as published.

truncated.description: True when available contributors remain after this page, including a zero-budget page.

urls.description: External links INSPIRE records for the paper.

title: Get INSPIRE paper
